# PromptBill (https://promptbill.online)

> Programmatic SEO Hub for LLM Benchmarks, Individual Model Pages, Head-to-Head Comparisons, Provider Hubs & Best Coding LLMs.

## Programmatic Routes
- /models/[slug] — Individual model specs, benchmark scores, rate limits, pricing history & cost calculator
- /compare/[model-a]-vs-[model-b] — Head-to-head pricing, speed (Tok/s), Elo & capability comparison
- /providers/[provider] — Provider-specific model directory & pricing
- /best-llms-for-coding — Best LLMs ranked for coding & agentic engineering
